lead_raw_text:
The structure of Cs2Ta2N2 (reduced formula CsTaN) crystallizes in the trigonal space group P3m1 (No. 15), with six atoms in the unit cell distributed across six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies Ta centers coordinated by six N neighbors, while N centers show both six-neighbor and one-neighbor environments toward Cs. Cs centers have twelve geometric neighbors, six Cs and six Ta, and the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals Ta-centered 6-vertex coordination polyhedra exhibiting corner- and edge-sharing, and Cs-centered 12-vertex polyhedra showing corner-, edge-, and face-sharing.
